title: Single-Port Robotic System – a Paradigm Shift in Robot-Assisted Radical Prostatectomy?
content: This study explores potential for the utilization of the Da Vinci sin-gle-port (SP) system in robotic-assisted radical prostatectomy (RARP) for prostate cancer. The SP system offers significant advancements in minimally invasive surgery, with benefits such as 360° operative field visualization, poten-tial for reduced blood loss, faster recovery, improved cosmetics, integrated op-tics and instruments, and enhanced depth perception. While comparable onco-logical and functional outcomes are achieved between SP and multi-port (MP) systems, the SP system presents a unique advantage in reducing surgical trauma. This study emphasizes the SP system’s potential to enhance patient care while acknowledging the steeper learning curve for surgeons.
